choiceSave.method: 2 warmups + 30 samples each. Server-Timing exclusive parse/validate+assembly/serialize(state and response)/atomic-write/other. Optional fs wrappers count temporary persistence-file bytes, fsync and rename without production hooks; no directory fsync in replaceFile. Includes unquantified instrumentation overhead; client is loopback fetch+JSON, not browser. D33 split ink files; choice saves never load ink.

bankReturn.method: 2 warmups + 30 returns from B to already-opened A (3 questions, 1 image). Actual DOM click to new iframe ready/host busy=false and next animation frame, both timed inside the browser. Radio enabled and image decoded are asserted after each sample. Resource durations overlap and must not be summed into total. No browser cache implementation. Synthetic small banks, not real mobile hardware.
